text:
maria_support: Customer Xero hit a 400 on POST /v1/rerank. They sent what looks like valid JSON but got `invalid request: could not parse body`. Sharing failing curl and headers from our request logs.

maria_support: ```
POST /v1/rerank HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Content-Type: text/plain
Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED

{
  "query": "best onboarding doc",
  "candidates": [
    {"id": 1, "text": "doc A"},
    {"id": 2, "text": "doc B"}
  ]
}
```

maria_support: API response (400): ```json
{"error":"invalid JSON payload: expected application/json Content-Type"}
```

ow_backend: @maria_support can you confirm raw bytes? Looks like the payload is JSON but header is text/plain — gateway refuses to parse.

maria_support: raw request body (from tcpdump): ```
{"query":"best onboarding doc","candidates":[{"id":1,"text":"doc A"}]}
```

ow_backend: yep — body is valid JSON bytes but header is text/plain. Our parser uses Content-Type to decide decoder path, so we return a 400 with that error. Common client bug: axios/fetch without JSON.stringify + manual header or some SDKs send text/plain.

ow_backend: quick repro/fix (works): ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"query":"best onboarding doc","candidates":[{"id":"1","text":"doc A"}]}'
```

devops_kate: I'll add a clearer 415/400 mapping on the API gateway so error messages suggest the header fix and include a diagnostics hint. Filing infra ticket: INFRA-2897. :memo:

ingrid: Logging note — we should surface header on support logs (strip auth) so we can triage faster. Adding a small change to the request-logger to log Content-Type and Content-Length for non-200 responses.

maria_support: I replied to the customer with the Content-Type fix and included the working curl. They confirmed it fixed the 400. Marking as resolved but keeping INFRA-2897 open for nicer errors/docs updates. :white_check_mark:

customer_xero_bot: Confirmed: switched to Content-Type: application/json, rerank returned 200 and scores. Thanks!

maria_support: Follow-ups: 1) docs PR to highlight Content-Type requirement on Rerank examples, 2) infra ticket for better gateway error, 3) add a short FAQ in support playbook. Assigning owners in ticket comments.
